question:
Study the graph and answer the question.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/29e32cc6f82e9b9b23d3ea71ff5f5d2f35a04bffa27f00ceb9c3e53e19c4ac3f.png] 

Total expenditure of all three companies together in the year 2018 was what percentage of the total expenditure of company B over all the years together?
solution:
**Formula Used:**

Percentage = (Part / Whole) × 100

**Calculation:**

Total expenditure of all three companies in 2018 = 387 + 432 + 476 = 1295 lakh

Total expenditure of Company B over all years = 120 + 297 + 408 + 432 + 426 = 1683 lakh

Percentage = (1295 / 1683) × 100

⇒ Percentage ≈ 76.95%

**∴ The total expenditure of all three companies together in 2018 was approximately 76.95% of the total expenditure of Company B over all the years together.**
